{{Top}}
[[File:Rogue3-TCG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Wedge Antilles flying as Rogue Three during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]]]
'''Rogue Three''' was the callsign used by certain fighter pilots of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]].

The pilots who have used the callsign include:
*[[Rus Kal Kin]] ([[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]])<ref name="SW15">[[Star Wars (2013) 15|''Star Wars'' (2013) 15]]</ref>
*[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] ([[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]])<ref name="TESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>
*[[Kirst (pilot)|Kirst]] ([[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]])<ref name="ADitL">{{Tales|12|A Day in the Life}}</ref>
*[[Nrin Vakil]] ([[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]])<ref name="XWRS:MR">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 35|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 35]]</ref>
*[[Nawara Ven]] ([[6 ABY/Legends|6.5 ABY]])<ref name="XW:RS">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref>
*[[Rhysati Ynr]] ([[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]])<ref name="XW:TKT">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref>
*[[Gavin Darklighter]] (7 ABY)<ref name="XW:TBW">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>
*[[Pedna Scotian]] (7 ABY)<ref name="XW:SC">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref>
*[[Kenn Nitram]] ([[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]])<ref name="DFR">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref><ref name="CSWE Rogue Three">{{CSWECite|III|107|Rogue Three}}</ref>
*[[Lyyr Zatoq]] (9 ABY)<ref name="XW:IR">''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]''</ref>
